categories.name: Lettering
categories.blurb: Words that move: big letterforms, credits, tickers and reading effects.

categories.name: Algorithms
categories.blurb: Maths and code that draw: fractals, automata, attractors.

categories.name: Demoscene
categories.blurb: Classic demo effects: fire, plasma, tunnels and warps.

pieces.name: Blinking Cursor
pieces.note: A minimal prompt in big block type where a short word is typed and erased beside a blinking block cursor.

pieces.name: Bouncing Letters
pieces.note: Block letters drop in one at a time, bounce with a little squash and settle on the floor before falling away.

pieces.name: Decode Reveal
pieces.note: A field of cipher noise gives way column by column as a block letter phrase decrypts out of it.

pieces.name: Digital Clock
pieces.note: A big seven segment clock ticking through the seconds, with ghosted unlit segments and a blinking colon.

pieces.name: Extruded Word Spin
pieces.note: A chunky 3D extruded word swings back and forth in space with a lit pink face and deep blue sides.

pieces.name: Kaleidoscope
pieces.note: An eightfold mirrored pattern that turns and shifts colour like a kaleidoscope.

pieces.name: Kinetic Word Slam
pieces.note: Big words zoom in from the camera one beat at a time and slam into place with a screen shake and a burst of dust.

pieces.name: Lava Crust Cracks
pieces.note: Plates of cooled black crust drift down a lava river, molten orange light glowing up through the cracks as they pull apart.

pieces.name: Lava Lamp
pieces.note: A glowing lamp where blobs of warm wax rise, merge, split and sink through violet liquid.

pieces.name: LED Matrix Scroller
pieces.note: A shop window LED matrix sign with a dotted grid of dark LEDs scrolling a two colour message in a chunky pixel font.

pieces.name: Metaballs
pieces.note: Glowing blobs drifting across the screen, merging and splitting like hot liquid.

pieces.name: Sine Plasma
pieces.note: A classic sine plasma, rainbow bands rolling and folding into each other.

pieces.name: Rotozoomer
pieces.note: The demoscene rotozoomer, a checkered XOR texture spinning and zooming in and out.

pieces.name: Starburst
pieces.note: Rainbow rays bursting from a white hot centre while rings pulse outward through them.

pieces.name: Texture Tunnel
pieces.note: A flight down an endless checkered tunnel that bends and twists as it goes.

pieces.name: Wave Interference
pieces.note: Two vibrating sources send out circular waves that reinforce and cancel, carving the classic fan of nodal lines as the sources drift apart.

pieces.name: Wave Text
pieces.note: Big block letters bob along a travelling sine wave, brightening at each crest, with shadows that shrink as they rise.
